task_title: Make shared state merge-safe in git (JSON files)
task_details:
state.db is binary -> git can't merge it; worktrees each get a copy; autoincrement ids collide. Fix: state.db back to gitignored local cache; tasks + handovers stored as one JSON file per record in .claude/state/ (git-tracked), random ids (t-xxxxxx/h-xxxxxx), auto re-import on get_conn when files change, write-through on CLI writes, handovers_delivered kept local.
[2026-09-10T08:16:54.663871+00:00 -> open] WIP 2026-09-10: lib/state_files.py written (file I/O, random ids, sync_from_files w/ signature + conflict-safe skip) but NOT wired in yet. Remaining: (1) schema.py: PRAGMA user_version=2 migration - export legacy tasks/todos/handovers rows to files (str ids), legacy delivered->handovers_delivered, drop old tables; new tables tasks(id TEXT PK), handovers(id TEXT PK, no delivered), handovers_delivered(handover_id PK), meta(key PK,value); get_conn calls sync_from_files in try/except. (2) lib/handovers.py use handovers_delivered. (3) ORDER BY priority, created_ts in lib/tasks.py + cli task-list. (4) cli/tasks.py + cli/handovers.py file-first: write_task/write_handover(new_id) then get_conn. (5) db.py --id type=str + docstrings. (6) .gitignore re-ignore .claude/state.db + .claude/state/**/*.tmp; .gitattributes '.claude/state/** text eol=lf'; git rm --cached .claude/state.db. (7) update CLAUDE.md + schema/db/db_history docstrings. (8) test in scratch copy: migration, add/status/log, session-start delivers once, delete db -> rebuild, 2-branch git merge clean, same-task conflict -> warning.
[2026-09-10T08:25:57.482179+00:00 -> closed] Done 2026-09-10: wired in. state.db is a gitignored local cache (schema v2 via PRAGMA user_version; legacy rows exported to .claude/state/ files, legacy delivered -> handovers_delivered). CLI writes are file-first, get_conn re-imports on file change, bad/conflicted file -> import skipped + warning (also shown in SessionStart context). recent_handovers now marks all older undelivered as delivered so a fresh checkout doesn't drip-feed history. Scratch test (migration, add/status/retitle/log, deliver-once, delete-db rebuild, clean 2-branch merge, same-task conflict warning + resolve) all pass.
